      public static String getDisplayNameOf(org.codehaus.groovy.ast.AnnotatedNode field)
      Returns the display name (or 'nice' name) of the given field. The display name is the first sentence of the AnnoDoc value of the field, or the field name if no AnnoDoc is present.
      Parameters:
      field - the field to get the display name of
      Returns:
      the display name
